---
title: "Benford's Law"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-24"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("data.table")
```


```{r data}
genomes100 <- fread("data/animal_plant_genomes_100.csv")
```

```{r}
# Custom function for mathematical extraction
get_first_digit <- function(x) {
  floor(abs(x) / (10 ^ floor(log10(abs(x)) + 1e-9)))
}
```


```{r digits, echo=FALSE}
first_digits <- get_first_digit(genomes100$genome_size_bp)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(table(first_digits))
df$proportion <- df$Freq/nrow(genomes100)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = first_digits, y = Freq)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity")
```

```{r data}
genomes1000 <- fread("data/genome_sizes_1000_template.csv")
```


```{r digits, echo=FALSE}
first_digits <- get_first_digit(genomes1000$genome_size_bp)
df <- data.frame(table(first_digits))
df$proportion <- df$Freq/nrow(genomes1000)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = first_digits, y = Freq)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity")
```
